axis_offset_interpretation.verdict: Mixture: Nova is inboard on 72.5% of evidence slices, but both components change sign by slice or shot and no coherent radial displacement explains the miss; the current centroid is 13.27 cm from Nova's axis and 14.46 cm from EFIT's, so an axis-centroid swap is not supported.

centroid_radial_verdict: Intermediate disagreement: Nova and EFIT current-centroid R differ by more than a few but less than about ten centimetres (median Nova - EFIT -5.62 cm) using level1 efm/current_centrd_r.
evidence_rule: converged free Nova slices in flat top with finite Nova and EFIT axes; a legacy conditioned flag is corrected only when target derivation failed before a zero-trip conditioned solve

flat_top_definition.slice_rule: interpolated absolute current >= 80% of shot maximum absolute current
